regions.merged_text: We all hope this finds you well - which, for one ex- periencing what you have been going through these several months, must mean that you are keeping up courage and by the grace of God continuing to foster confidence in His merciful wisdom and goodness - all the better of course if the physical condition, at least does non get worse, till we see a decided im- provement and final recovery, God willing. The purpose of this card, since I cannot finish the letter I wanted to send you, is primarily, to just reassure you that we are keeping you in mind and please God will not forget you in our prayers.
